tei:div.tei:p: jo bo rje'i slob rgyud dang*/ bka' gdams pa'i byon tshul bzhugs so

/ ོ/ na mo ratna gu ru bhyaḥ gangs chen ljongs 'dir thub bstan gsal ba dang*// snyigs dus 'gro rnams smin grol 'god pa'i phyir/ /jo bo yab sras bka' gdams rgyud pa rnams/ /byon pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar 'di ltar snang/ /bod du bka' gdams pa'i rgyud pa byung tshul ni/ dang po rgya gar gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho bzang po'i gdung rus las chad pa/ jo bo di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes pa de'i yab ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi za hor rgyal po dge ba'i dpal gyis sras gsum gyi 'bring po mtshan zla ba'i snying po/ gzhon nu nas dge 'dun phal chen sde pa la rab tu byung nas/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gnas brtan mdzad pa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha zhes pa mtshan yongs su grags pa des rgya gar du 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad cing*/ chu pho rta lo la dgung lo drug cu re gnyis bzhes pa/ bod la byon nas bal por lo gcig mnga' ris stod du lo gnyis/ gtsang du lo gcigadabus su lo bdun zla ba lnga'i bar la bzhugs/ bstan pa nyin mo ltar cher gsal bar mdzad nas/ don gsum pa shing pho rta lo dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la/ snye thang 'or nas dga' ldan du sku gshegs so/ /de nyid la rgya bod na slob ma mang du yod cing*/ bod du thugs sras kyi mchog khu rngog 'brom gsum/ de'i nang nas kyang bka' gdams pa'i mes po/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas de/ stod lung snam kyi bye ma lung pa/ rten dge bsnyen yin/ jo bo rje dang mnga' ris su mjal/ rwa sgreng dgon pa btab/ de'i sras thu bo mched gsum ni/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dang*/ pu to rin chen gsal/ spyan mnga' ba rin chen 'bar te/ khams pa lung pa dang*/ bzhir yang grags so/ /pu to ba'i sras kyi mthu bo bu chen bzhir grags pa'i nang nas/ dbur stod kyi zhang sha ra ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ de'i sras bka' babs bzhir grags pa'i nang nas/ byang sems kyi bka' babs/

bya 'chad ka ba/ de'i slob ma se spyil bu pa/ des spyil bu btab/ de na slob rgyud rim pa bzhin/ lha rin po che 'gro ba'i mgon po/ lha lung gi dbang phyug lha zur khang pa/ rnal 'byor byang seng*/ des gro sa dgon pa btab/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas dar des mkha' ru dgon pa btab/ pu to ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags kyis/ snar thang btab ste/ chos lung sku gshegs su grags so/ /de'i gdan sa sding dkar sku gshegs/ shes rab grags kyis snar thang zhes pa'i ming btags/ de nas zhang btsun rdo rje 'od/ de gsum ga'i slob ma gro bdud rtsi grags/ de la bla ma yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs shing*/ sangs rgyas stong gi ya gyal du grags/ de nas zhang staun chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ de'i ring la dha na shī la'i slob ma/ skyi nag grags seng gis mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa btsugs/ bcom ldan ral gri la sogs byung*/ byang chen btab/ de nas mchims nam mkha' grags/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bla ma dang*/ chu mig chos 'khor chen mo'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ lha khang rny-ing ma bzhengs/ de nas skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ des gtsug lag khang chen mo dang*/ lcags ri bzhengs/ de nas chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas/ tshul khrims stag brgyad bskos/ chos khrims dag ther cher mdzad/ der rting 'dul 'dzin grags brtson ze'u bas/ se chen dang ol ja du rgyal po'i dus/ bstan pa dang gdan sa la phan thogs/ der rting grags che ba/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ 'dis sha khrims dang*/ khams pa mi bsten pa'i khrims mdzad de/ de la sogs pa gzhung 'chad nyan mdzad pa rnams/ pu to ba'i rgyud sde bka' gdams gzhung par grags so/ /pu to ba'i bu chen spyan lnga tshul khrims 'bar gyis/ lo pa'i gnas brtan bgres po zhig 'dug pa la/ brid skol byas/ tshogs pa nam tshogs dus bsngo ba ster ba'i dam bcas nas/ lo dgon pa btab/

de slob ma stod lung pa rin chen snying gis/ btsan gro dgon pa btab nas/ de'i dbon po gzhon nu 'od kyis/ bya yul btab/ de la slob ma chen po bcu bzhir grags pa'i nang nas/ mal gro sprul pa chen po'i rgyal po stengs btab/ khrom zher ba chen pos kam kam btab/ dum bu ri ba chen pos/dum ri btab/ sgyer sgom chen pos/ /rgya ma'i mchod khang rnying ma dang*/rin chen sgang btab bo/ /bya yul du der rting mkhan rab bcu gcig song ba'i rjes la/ spyan mnga' tshul khrims mgon po bya ba'i/ gdan sa 'di pa chos gang bzang re ma gtogs/ dbon rgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i srol med do/ /rgya ma sgyer sgom chen po'i rjes la/ sa skya dbon gyi lha khang gsar ma btab/ de nas dbon rgyud rim pa bzhin gyi/ drug pa slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'dis gdan sa/ sgyer gyi gdung rgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa'i srol yin no/ /yang jo bo rje'i slob ma'i bla mchod bzhir grags pa slob rgyud/ kha rag sne zur ba/ gtsang na grags po lung*/ spyi bo lhas pa la sogs/ gdams ngag gtso bor ston pas/ bka' gdams gdams ngag par grags so/ /yang chos rje pa'i slob ma lo tsā ba/ de'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba'i dgon pa bcom chung bya ba/ rwa sgreng gi 'og na yod pa'i/ bka' gdams 'og mar grags/ de dang rwa sgreng gnyis la bka' gdams gong 'og zer ro/ /rong pa'i bu bzhir grags pa'i/ rnam par ba chen pos rnam thar dang*/ ram pa lha sdings btab/ gsang phu ne'u thog gi gdan sa'ang lo bdun mdzad/ de dag ni rong pa'i bka' brgyud dar lags so// bka' gdams rgyud 'di bris pas rgyal ba'i bka'//bka' bsdu gsum nas ma 'chugs rgyud pa'i bka'/ /bka' yis zab don gdams pa bstan pa yis// rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gro kun smin grol shog /dge legs 'phel bar shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/jo bo rje'i slob rgyud dang*/
